title: EvaluatorPromotionEvaluateData
description: Decision returned by POST .../evaluator-promotion/evaluate: the persisted decision projection plus audit_status.

decision_id.description: Identifier of the persisted decision row.

decision.description: Advisory outcome. promote: challenger recommended on a strictly positive lower bound; hold: incumbent retained (tie, non-positive bound, or a failed evaluator-quality audit); insufficient_evidence: too few shared anchor-backed pairs, or nothing to compare against; abstain: no verifiable anchor evidence.

lcb.description: Conservative lower bound on the mean paired agreement difference; null unless a bound was computed.

point_diff.description: Mean paired agreement difference (challenger minus incumbent); null when there were no pairs. Unbounded: with too few pairs the raw mean of finite scores is stored as is.

n_pairs.description: Number of shared anchor-backed pairs used.

delta.description: The delta the decision was computed with.

anchor_type.description: Anchor evidence class used: verifiable, proxy (present but proxy-only) or none.

incumbent_fingerprint.description: Incumbent evaluator fingerprint, lowercase hex of 16 to 64 characters; the empty string when no incumbent could be resolved.

challenger_only_wins.description: Count of pairs where only the challenger agreed with the anchor.

incumbent_only_wins.description: Count of pairs where only the incumbent agreed with the anchor.

created_at.description: When the decision was recorded, ISO 8601.

audit_status.description: Evaluator-quality audit status for the run at decision time. "missing" when no audit exists for the run, and on servers that predate the audit_unavailable value also when the audit lookup fails; "audit_unavailable" when the lookup fails, on servers that report it; "audit_stale" when the stored audit predates the current eligibility rules; otherwise the stored audit status. Present on the POST response only.
